written: 2026-09-24, before any E4 call. Gold: the sealed labels_A/B.json of the municipal test (hashes in jev-test/muni/results/seal.json).
question: Does Winnow's 'structured' criteria format (GhalebDweikat/winnow, sidecar/src/winnow/questions.py:43-70: criteria values as {what, not_for, examples}) improve the E3 topic question on our 75 municipal chunks?

design.bodies: E3's logged request bodies (typesafe-test/proxy_log.jsonl), byte-identical in model, state and instructions; only questions.topic.criteria changes
design.criteria_rule: mechanical, from the E3 texts, not tuned to E3's errors: for each of the ten categories {what: <label>, examples: <description split at commas>, not_for: SHARED_NOT_FOR}; none_of_these: {what: 'The passage's own content concerns none of these topics', examples: ['page furniture: navigation, a cookie notice, contact details or other page furniture with no substantive content', 'a passage whose subject is not among the listed topics']}
design.SHARED_NOT_FOR: A topic the passage only mentions in passing; page furniture (navigation, a cookie notice, contact details or other page furniture with no substantive content) has no topic.
design.why_shared_not_for_is_fair: it restates two rules both labellers were given (LABELLING rules: passing mentions do not count; a junk chunk has no primary categories), using the production boilerplate wording (corpus/describe.py:60-61)
design.fallback: if the API rejects object-valued choice criteria (HTTP 4xx), encode each as one string 'What: … Examples: … Not for: …' and record that change here before re-running

transport: direct POST to Vercel's TypeSafe-compatible route, one at a time, 1 s apart, honouring retry-after
decision_rule: same as E3: predicted = {choice} unless none_of_these
compare: E4 vs E3 on the same gold: precision/recall with Wilson CIs, false topics on agreed junk, per-chunk sign test; AUC over (chunk, topic) pairs using each design's topic probabilities (also M1's noul probabilities), following Winnow's lesson that calibration alone can mislead
caveat: in-sample like E3: the author of the criteria had seen E3's errors; the mechanical rule limits, but does not remove, that bias
